newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close higher, Rao exit boosts buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close higher, Rao exit boosts buying.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse closed higher as local and foreign funds made hectic purchases, boosted by the resignation of former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index jumped 8.73 points to close at 678.78.

"The brisk buying is mainly attributed to some solution in the Congress party as the former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao resigned on demand of the party," said Ronald of brokers Spurt Securities.
Rao on Thursday resigned from his last party post as chief of the Congress party's parliamentary bloc amid a flurry of corruption charges.
ACC rose 20 rupees to close at 1,193.
Reliance Industries quoted 6.10 rupees higher at 204.10.
